rule: FROZEN. These are the only terms permitted for these concepts. Use the app_term in all UI text and prose. Never introduce a synonym. The guiding principle from the brief is: avoid unnecessarily renaming familiar concepts, so an SAP-experienced user needs minimal retraining.

terms.tooltip: The top-level capital project. Carries the CAPEX code that follows every downstream procurement and accounting transaction.

terms.zoho_erp_term: No equivalent - Zoho ERP Projects are flat; nesting exists only under Tasks via parent_id
terms.client_preferred_term: Not present in the client document
terms.tooltip: A node in the work breakdown structure. Carries budget, commitment, actual and available values, and rolls up to its parent.
SAP's scheduling and execution layer below the WBS. Out of scope for this application, which is a financial control system, not a scheduling tool.
A dated checkpoint on a project or WBS element, used for progress reporting and stage gating.
The authorised spending limit. Distinct from a cost plan, which is an estimate and carries no control effect.
The first approved budget. Immutable - never overwritten. Revisions are recorded separately.
An approved increase to the budget, recorded as a separate versioned line with requestor, approver, reason and date.
An approved reduction, releasing budget no longer required.
Movement of approved budget between WBS elements or budget heads. Net-zero at the level above.
Open PO commitment plus actual CWIP. Note SAP's own authoritative definition is broader - see section 22 for the difference and its consequence.

terms.zoho_erp_term: Not computed by Zoho - derived by this application from purchase order lines
terms.tooltip: The unbilled balance of approved purchase orders. Reduces as bills are posted, so a PO is never counted twice.
Cost actually booked to the project through vendor bills and approved journals.
Current Approved Budget less exposure. The figure checked before any new commitment is permitted.
The control that evaluates available budget before a transaction is approved, and routes an over-budget transaction to exception approval or revision.
The utilisation level at which the system warns, requires exception approval, or blocks.
The instruction that determines which fixed asset or cost centre each portion of accumulated CWIP is transferred to.
Accumulated capital expenditure not yet capitalised to a fixed asset.
Physical work is complete. Further procurement is blocked, but financial postings may continue until financial completion.
Terminal state. No procurement and no posting. Reopening requires approval and is recorded in the audit trail.
A configurable status set by users to reflect a business stage, in addition to the system-derived status.
Set by the system from what has actually happened to the object. Cannot be edited directly.

terms.zoho_erp_term: Product feature exists; NO public API - see OAS-02
terms.tooltip: The internal request that triggers the budget availability check before a purchase order is raised.
Confirmation that goods or services were received. Creates received-but-unbilled exposure until the vendor bill arrives.
The supplier's invoice. Converts open commitment into actual CWIP without changing total exposure.

terms.zoho_erp_term: Chart of Accounts entry or reporting tag
terms.tooltip: The spending category a budget is approved against - for example Civil, Plant and Machinery, Electrical.
